body:
Triangle is now Offense (Red) > Operations (Yellow) > Defense (Blue) > Offense (old relationships preserved: old middle kind = Operations). Every Operations card carries one of Lock/Sabotage/Flank/Scan/Siphon (7 each). Existing cards re-sorted into the colour they fit, none removed; 32 new cards so each colour has 35. PARENA card_keyword + kind table, regenerated C/Java/Python/parity (24k vectors), hand-typed oracle, wire proto 3, art regenerated, Windows GUI/Android/WOTAN show kind + keyword, docs rewritten. All local tests + Bazel APK build green. NOT deployed to the live server/bots/WOTAN (old clients would be refused by proto 3).

⚓ ☃
title: DEADWEIGHT retheme: Offense/Operations/Defense triangle, Operations keywords, 105 cards, legacy terms removed
